name: Leelanau County, Michigan (United States)
description: Light blue upper part with white rays radiating from the centre, over a blue lower part for Lake Michigan, charged with the county seal: a green map of the Leelanau Peninsula in a ring reading LEELANAU COUNTY Est. 1863.
history: Leelanau County is a county located in Michigan. The flag was adopted in 2009 (the design by Matthew Shoaff, chosen from 26 entries, was approved by the county board of commissioners in a 5–2 vote in 2009, according to Flags of the World citing the Leelanau Enterprise; the county had previously found it had only a 1976 bicentennial flag).

features.role: county seal with a green map of the peninsula, reading LEELANAU COUNTY Est. 1863
